name: Shemiramoth
overview: Shemiramoth was a male Levite who held the significant role of a gatekeeper, ranked second among the Levites according to 1 Chronicles 15:18. His duties likely involved responsibilities related to the temple gates, a vital function in the worship life of Israel. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide additional personal details about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Shemiramoth means 'heights' or 'heavens,' and it may also be a proper name associated with a pagan goddess, though this is not confirmed. This name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 15:18 and is not indicated to be given by God.
familyAndRelationships: Shemiramoth is explicitly identified as a descendant of Levi, situating him within the priestly tribe entrusted with temple service. Scripture does not record any further family relationships for him beyond this tribal affiliation.
scriptureSignificance: Shemiramoth's mention as a second rank Levite and gatekeeper highlights his role in maintaining the sanctity and order of the temple worship during the time of David's preparations for the ark's return. His service reflects the faithful stewardship entrusted to the Levites, emphasizing the importance of dedicated roles in God's covenant community. His inclusion in the biblical record underscores the organized and reverent approach to worship under God's direction.
